description: The floodplain inundation history of the Murray-Darling Basin through two-monthly maximum water depth maps is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by David J. Penton et al. With growing concerns over water management in rivers worldwide, researchers are seeking methods to monitor and understand changing flood patterns. Coverage: global (AU); published in 2023. Formats: GeoTIFF, Image. The data are held in CSIRO Data Access Portal and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 23.19 GB. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
